name: jev-solver
description: One skill, solve, for coding tasks after the superpowers plugin (design, plan, execute, debug, review, verify as references, a decider agent for --headless runs); it triages the task through the jev-api tools and keeps specs and plans in the session scratchpad.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Minimum confidence (0 to 1) of a jev-api choice or noul answer that the skills accept for a decision; below it, or on an error, Claude decides itself (unset: 0.6).
